shot_01.prompt: Photorealistic live-action 65mm cinema wide establishing shot inside a warm, luxurious lived-in California modern oceanfront penthouse living room in Marina del Rey at sunset twilight. Absolutely zero concrete walls, no industrial brutality. Wide-plank honey European oak hardwood floors, warm cedar-slat wood ceiling with subtle warm recessed lighting, a cozy cream boucle sofa with warm throw pillows, a low travertine stone fireplace with a soft flickering flame, a potted indoor Mediterranean olive tree, open floating shelves with architectural art books, and a warm mid-century brass floor lamp. Fully open floor-to-ceiling motorized sliding glass doors lead onto an expansive teak wood balcony deck with seamless glass railings overlooking an unobstructed, breathtaking panoramic vista of the Marina del Rey harbor water, luxury yacht masts, coastal palm trees, and the Pacific Ocean horizon under a golden-hour violet-rose sunset sky. On the right, at a custom live-edge American walnut and brushed-aluminum executive desk with a frameless 32-inch Apple Pro Display XDR monitor, sits the 38-year-old systems architect (#01 Alexei from the reference portrait: short dark hair, sharp jawline, light 3-day stubble, wearing a fitted dark charcoal merino crewneck sweater). Standing neatly beside his desk is a sleek custom 12-core anodized titanium-and-walnut desktop workstation tower: 11 core modules glow in calm cool cyan-teal, while Core #04 (bottom right module) glows hot in violent warning crimson-orange at 100% CPU overload, quietly venting a delicate thin plume of thermal steam. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70, Kodak Vision3 500T color science, Roger Deakins warm motivated lighting, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, live-action cinema realism.

ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70, warm tungsten practical lighting, fine 35mm film grain, photorealistic live-action realism.
